notes.title: iOS Version Release Date is May 28th! Price: $1.99!
notes.notes:
Per the title, May 28th will be the release date for the iOS version of Sacred Tears TRUE and the price will be $1.99. Btw, there will be NO ads, in-app purchases, or personal data usage-type shenanigans! 

We'll post one final update on release day!

notes.title: DOUBLE BIG News! The Sacred Tears TRUE is Now $1.99! iOS Version on the Way!
notes.notes:
The Sacred Tears TRUE is one of the projects that we're most proud to have worked on here at Nyu Media and we're pleased to announce...

1!! It is now only $1.99!

2!! We are now working on an iOS port and will announce details and the release date shortly!

Thanks, as ever, for your support and we hope you enjoy The Sacred Tears TRUE!

notes.title: Release Date Announced! Sept 25th!
notes.notes:
So the release date for Sacred Tears TRUE is now fixed - it'll release on Steam from September 25th. (Argh, that’s soon!!) 

We LOVE this game (did we mention that!) and very much looking forward to bringing it to you!
